text: Bergstra and Bengio showed that ___, which samples hyperparameter configurations at random, is competitive with (and often more efficient than) grid search when only a few hyperparameters matter.
explanation: Sections 8.1/8.8 and the lab cite Bergstra & Bengio (2012): because the loss has low effective dimensionality, random search covers the important 1–2 dimensions as densely as a 1-D scan, so 50–100 samples rival grids of hundreds to thousands of points.
